t: Signature Ghidra: What Ghidra Is: The Disassembler That Reads for You
title: Signature Ghidra: What Ghidra Is: The Disassembler That Reads for You
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigLens-RE bench, Manon's original binary-analysis design. It mirrors the disassemble-decompile-script pipeline but every analysis project carries a provenance record — which binary, which hash, whose firmware, under what authority. The Signature design makes the authority part of the project: you analyze what you are entitled to analyze.

title: Signature Ghidra: The Decompiler: From Bytes to Logic
description: The bench's decompiler is the translator: same lifting, but it tracks your markup as annotations with confidence levels. The Signature design versions the annotations — the analysis is a document with history, so a second analyst can see how the understanding was built.
key_facts: Analyst guides with names and types

t: Signature Ghidra: Firmware Analysis: Your Own Devices
title: Signature Ghidra: Firmware Analysis: Your Own Devices
description: The bench's firmware doctrine is the owner's right: analyze what you own, document what you find. The Signature design requires the finding's disposition — patched, mitigated, accepted, or vendor-notified — recorded before the project closes. Findings without dispositions are not findings; they are worries.

demo.code:
var findings=[['hardcoded creds','vendor notified'],['weak update sig','patched']];
findings.forEach(function(f){console.log(f[0]+' -> '+f[1]);});
